repos.name: mikehasa/agentacct
repos.description: See what your coding agents did and what it cost. Breaks each task down into work steps — tools used, files changed, tests run, time and tokens spent. Local-first dashboard for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and more. No login, no telemetry.
repos.one_liner: A local-first observability and cost-tracking dashboard specifically designed for AI coding agents.
bullets: Tech Stack: Python-based local-first architecture designed to intercept and parse agent logs.
Purpose: Provides granular visibility into agentic workflows, including token consumption, latency, and tool execution success.
Use Cases: Financial auditing of AI development costs, debugging agentic task failures, and optimizing prompt engineering for cost-efficiency.
Compatibility: Supports popular coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, and OpenDevin.
repos.img_alt: agentacct tui — live usage, cost, provider rate-limit bars, and recent sessions with per-session weekly-plan-cost estimates
repos.img2_alt: agentacct tui session detail — the per-step work ledger with pass/fail check evidence and a weekly-plan-cost estimate

repos.name: simonlin1212/vibe-astock
repos.description: A 股短线复盘看板：涨停池·连板梯队·龙虎榜·板块资金一屏看完，赚钱效应/晋级率/梯队断层/情绪周期等派生指标纯计算直出（不经过 AI），AI 只把数据串成能读的盘面研判。全本地运行，可用 Claude/Codex 订阅免 API key。| A-share short-term daily-review dashboard: derived sentiment metrics computed locally, AI only writes the narrative. No API key needed.
repos.one_liner: A local-first A-share market sentiment and short-term trading dashboard using deterministic metrics.
bullets: Tech Stack: Python-based dashboard that separates deterministic financial calculations from AI-driven narrative synthesis.
Purpose: Visualizes market sentiment, liquidity flow, and 'money-making' effects without relying on LLM hallucinations for core data.
Use Cases: Real-time monitoring of A-share limit-up pools, ladder tiers, and institutional capital flows for short-term traders.
Privacy: Operates entirely locally, allowing users to integrate LLMs for analysis without exposing sensitive trading data via API keys.

repos.name: Flaminis/Dalaran
repos.description: Dalaran — Apache-2.0, robotics-first visualization and data infrastructure for multimodal time-series. ROS 2 native, reads existing .rrd recordings. A hard fork of Rerun.
repos.one_liner: A high-performance, ROS 2-native visualization and data infrastructure for multimodal time-series analysis.
bullets: Tech Stack: Rust-based architecture, hard-forked from Rerun, optimized for high-throughput robotics and sensor data.
Purpose: Provides a robust framework for visualizing and analyzing complex, time-synchronized multimodal datasets.
Use Cases: Analyzing high-frequency financial time-series data, sensor fusion in robotics, and debugging complex event-driven systems.
Compatibility: Native support for existing .rrd recordings and seamless integration with ROS 2 ecosystems.
